name: nflverse / nfldata Game Schedules & Lines
data_type: Historical & Future Schedules, Spreads, Totals, Moneylines, Weather, Referees, QBs
nfl_relevance: Primary foundation for games, schedules, spreads, totals, weather, coaches, and starting QBs.
historical_availability: Complete coverage from 1999 through 2025 seasons (7,276 regular season & playoff games).
current_live_availability: Full 2026 season schedule (272 games) with Week 1/2 scores and upcoming market consensus lines.
update_frequency: Nightly during season, weekly in offseason.
api_availability: Direct raw GitHub CSV / GitHub REST API / nflreadr / nflreadpy.
usage_limitations: GitHub API rate limits (60 req/hr unauth, 5,000 req/hr with GITHUB_TOKEN).
provenance: Curated by Lee Sharpe / nflverse analytics consortium.
granularity: Game-level metadata, point-in-time opening/closing market prices.
known_limitations: Pre-season games excluded; weather variables only recorded for outdoor stadiums.

name: nflverse Sportsbook Closing Lines Archive
data_type: Point Spreads, Totals, Moneylines with Exact Odds & Outright Settlement
nfl_relevance: Provides 20,490 verified market lines for unbiased closing-line and CLV benchmarking.
provenance: Aggregated from regulated sportsbook consensus (Pinnacle, Westgate SuperBook, DraftKings).
granularity: Per-market side, line, and American odds.
known_limitations: Only closing prices; tick-by-tick orderbook requires dedicated feeds.

name: nflverse Initial / Opening Lines
data_type: Opening Spreads, Totals, Moneylines for RLM and Steam Detection
nfl_relevance: Opening vs closing line movement for sharp money and market movement strategies.
historical_availability: 2006-2025 (1,089 opening lines in local mirror, full archive larger).
current_live_availability: Weekly opening lines Sunday night / Monday morning.
known_limitations: Only major markets; alt lines require sportsbook APIs.

name: NFL.com Official League Injury & Game Status Report
data_type: Official NFL Game Status Designations (OUT, DOUBTFUL, QUESTIONABLE), Practice Participation
nfl_relevance: Primary official ground truth for player availability, Friday status designations, and practice reports.
current_live_availability: Live for 2026 Season Week 1 and Week 2 across all 32 NFL clubs (834 players).
update_frequency: Wednesday, Thursday, Friday official report releases (~4 PM ET).
api_availability: Structured web payload / NFLInjuryReport collector mirror.
usage_limitations: HTML page scraping subject to web layout updates; nfl.com private JSON API requires OAuth.
provenance: National Football League Official Personnel Notice.
granularity: Player-level status (DNP, LP, FP, Out, Questionable, Doubtful).
known_limitations: Does not provide minute-precision update clocks or beat reporter attribution (ESPN used for clock).

name: NFL.com Official Player & Team Statistics
data_type: Official Player Stats, Team Stats, Passing, Rushing, Receiving, Defense
nfl_relevance: Official league statistics for QB, RB, WR, TE, OL, DL, LB, secondary.
historical_availability: Complete stats back to 1932 via NFL GSIS.
current_live_availability: Live 2026 season stats updated within 15 min of game completion.
update_frequency: Real-time during games, final after review.
cost_classification: Free public view; API requires key but nflverse mirror is free.
usage_limitations: Direct NFL API scraping restricted; use nflverse mirror for automation.
known_limitations: Advanced metrics (EPA, CPOE) not on official site; require nflfastR.

name: NFL Next Gen Stats (NGS) Tracking System
data_type: Player Tracking, Route Participation, Separation, Pressure, Time to Throw, Completion Probability, CPOE
nfl_relevance: Derived metrics: CPOE, completion probability, expected rushing yards, pressure, EPA/play, route participation, personnel packages.
current_live_availability: Weekly updates Tuesday via nflverse mirror.
api_availability: AWS-powered NGS via nflverse/nflfastR; direct scraping blocked.
cost_classification: Free via nflverse community mirror; direct NGS requires partnership.
usage_limitations: Direct NGS API not public; use nflverse mirror.
provenance: NFL Next Gen Stats / Zebra RFID tracking.
known_limitations: Pre-2016 seasons lack tracking; early 2016 partial coverage.

name: nflverse nflfastR Play-by-Play with EPA & CPOE
data_type: Play-by-Play, EPA, EPA/play, Success Rate, CPOE, Win Probability, Air Yards, Pressure
nfl_relevance: Core for QB EPA, EPA/dropback, CPOE, success rate, pressure response, blitz response, explosive plays, turnover rates, red-zone efficiency.
current_live_availability: Nightly during season via nflverse releases.
usage_limitations: Large file sizes (500MB+ per season Parquet).
provenance: nflverse / Ben Baldwin, Sebastian Carl, Lee Sharpe.
known_limitations: None major; gold standard.

name: ESPN Public NFL Hidden Endpoints & Scoreboard Feed
data_type: Live Play-by-Play, In-Game Scores, Minute-by-Minute Injury Timestamps, Team Rosters
nfl_relevance: Provides lowest-latency live game updates, in-game box scores, and reporter attribution.
update_frequency: Sub-second during live games, every 10 minutes otherwise.
usage_limitations: Unofficial API contract; per-team injury sub-endpoint returns empty dict.
licensing: ESPN Terms of Service / Personal Non-Commercial Research.
granularity: Play-by-play, sub-second state, minute-level injury timestamps.
known_limitations: ESPN team injury endpoints occasionally drop roster ties.

name: FiveThirtyEight NFL Elo Rating Database
data_type: Pre-game Elo Ratings, QB Value Adjustments, Win Probabilities, Margin Multipliers
nfl_relevance: Gold standard quantitative baseline for team strength and spread calibration.
known_limitations: Model updates ceased when FiveThirtyEight sports division restructured; dynamically maintained in NFLComp engine.

name: Kalshi Prediction Markets API & Historical Archive
data_type: Binary YES/NO Event Contracts, Point Spread & Total Point Brackets, Bid/Ask Orderbooks
nfl_relevance: Prediction market pricing, retail sentiment, market-implied probabilities, binary trade execution.
current_live_availability: Live prediction markets for NFL 2026 Season.
cost_classification: Free API access; trading fees apply to live fills ($0.01 per contract taker fee).
usage_limitations: Rate limit 10-30 req/sec; sandbox paper trading simulated in NFLComp.
granularity: 1-minute bars, orderbook depth, tick-by-tick trade prints.
known_limitations: Orderbook depth thinner on low-profile matchups; simulated execution bounded at $500 size.

name: NOAA National Weather Service Gridded Forecasts
data_type: Point-in-Time Stadium Temperature, Wind Speed, Gusts, Precipitation Probability
nfl_relevance: Verifying wind (>15 mph) and extreme freezing temperatures for totals strategies.
historical_availability: Historical station climatology via NOAA NCEI.
current_live_availability: Hourly gridded forecasts for all 32 NFL stadium coordinates.
usage_limitations: Requires standard User-Agent header; rate limit ~10 req/sec.
provenance: US National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration.
accuracy_rating: 99.0% observed vs forecast within 6-hour gameday window.
known_limitations: Indoor domed stadiums have zero wind impact.

name: Pro-Football-Reference Advanced Statistics Mirror
data_type: Pass Pressure Rates, Hurries, Knockdowns, Blitz Rates, Coverage Splits, Broken Tackles
nfl_relevance: Offensive line pass blocking efficiency and defensive havoc modeling.
usage_limitations: Direct scraping of pro-football-reference.com restricted; nflverse mirror used.
licensing: Sports Reference LLC / nflverse community mirror.
granularity: Weekly player-level and team-level pressure/blitz/coverage metrics.
known_limitations: Tracking begins in 2018 season; earlier years lack pressure data.

name: Pro-Football-Reference Team Statistics
data_type: Team Offensive & Defensive Stats, Red Zone, 3rd Down, 4th Down, Pace
nfl_relevance: Team-level efficiency: red-zone, 3rd-down, 4th-down decisions, pace, run/pass tendencies.
granularity: Team per season and per game.
known_limitations: HTML layout changes require parser updates.

name: nflverse Rosters & Depth Charts
data_type: Weekly Rosters, Depth Charts, Snap Counts, Personnel Packages
nfl_relevance: Starting lineups, OL continuity, skill-position injuries, snap counts, target shares, route participation.
granularity: Player per week depth chart and snap counts.
known_limitations: Depth chart is official team release, not actual starting lineup confirmation.

name: nflverse Snap Counts & Participation
data_type: Snap Counts, Target Shares, Route Participation, Personnel Usage, Carry Share
nfl_relevance: Player prop strategies: role, snap rate, route participation, target share, red-zone usage, goal-line usage.
granularity: Player per game snap counts and participation.
known_limitations: Pre-2012 limited snap count data.

name: The Odds API - Historical & Current Betting Prices
data_type: Moneylines, Point Spreads, Totals, Alternate Spreads, Team Totals, Player Props, Live/In-Game
nfl_relevance: Current prices, historical prices, opening/closing, timestamped prices, line movement, market depth.
current_live_availability: Real-time odds from 30+ sportsbooks (DraftKings, FanDuel, Pinnacle, etc.).
api_availability: REST JSON API with API key.
cost_classification: Freemium: 500 free requests/month, then paid tiers $29-$500/month.
usage_limitations: Free tier limited; historical requires paid.
provenance: The Odds API / multiple sportsbook aggregation.
granularity: Per sportsbook per market per timestamp.
known_limitations: Free tier insufficient for full historical backtest; use nflverse for free historical.

name: Pinnacle Sportsbook API
data_type: Sharp Closing Lines, Market Depth, Low-Vig Odds
nfl_relevance: Gold standard for closing line value (CLV) and sharp market pricing.
cost_classification: Free API with funded Pinnacle account; no fee for read.
known_limitations: US players cannot bet at Pinnacle; use for benchmarking only.

name: Action Network Public Betting Data
data_type: Public Betting Percentages, Sharp/Public Disagreement, Line Movement
nfl_relevance: Public betting research, reverse line movement, market consensus.
current_live_availability: Live public betting % updated every 15 min.
cost_classification: Freemium: public % free, detailed splits paywalled (Action Pro $49/month).
usage_limitations: Detailed splits behind paywall; free view limited.
accuracy_rating: Estimated from sportsbook ticket data, not 100% precise.
known_limitations: Public % is estimated sample, not full market.

name: RotoWire NFL Lineups & Inactive Wire
data_type: Projected and Confirmed Starters, Inactive Lists 90 Minutes Before Kickoff
nfl_relevance: Late game-time inactive detection and backup QB confirmation.
historical_availability: No official historical API; current live only.
cost_classification: Free public web view for starters; detailed injury report is paywalled.
usage_limitations: HTML scraping subject to rate throttling and blocking.
known_limitations: Paywalled for historical export; used as secondary confirmation only.

name: FTN Data & BetLabs Historical Betting Database
data_type: Historical Betting Prices, System Builder, Trends, Player Props History
nfl_relevance: Historical backtesting of public strategies, system builder, trends.
usage_limitations: No API; web scraping against ToS.
known_limitations: Paid and no API; used for discovery only, not automated.

name: nflverse Officials / Referee Assignments
data_type: Referee Assignments, Crew Penalties, Home/Away Tendencies
nfl_relevance: Referee tendencies: penalty rates, home bias, total points, DPI, holding.
known_limitations: Crew penalty averages require aggregation; not directly in file.

name: DraftKings Sportsbook Player Props
data_type: Player Props: Passing Yards, Rushing Yards, Receiving Yards, Receptions, Anytime TD, Sacks, Tackles
nfl_relevance: Player prop market pricing and line movement.
current_live_availability: Live props updated continuously on gameday.
api_availability: DraftKings private API (requires reverse engineering) + Odds API aggregation.
usage_limitations: No official public API; use Odds API or manual.
granularity: Per player per prop per timestamp.
known_limitations: Prop lines move quickly; historical archive requires paid service.

name: FanDuel Sportsbook Player Props & Game Props
data_type: Player Props, Game Props, Team Props, Same-Game Parlay Components
nfl_relevance: Player props, game props, team props for prop strategies.
known_limitations: Historical requires aggregation.

name: NFLWeather.com Historical Weather Database
data_type: Historical Weather: Wind, Temperature, Precipitation, Field Conditions
nfl_relevance: Historical weather for backtesting wind and temperature totals strategies.
cost_classification: Free public view; API not official.

name: MasterSite CEO / Executive Index (Mapping Review)
data_type: Directory of 44 Verified Projects, Including CEO, Weather, Insider Trades, TheLeap
nfl_relevance: Reviewed for NFL data reuse; no CEO project exists as standalone signal per StockPaperSim audit, but directory provides verified GitHub Pages inventory.

name: MasterSite SFWeather - NOAA NWS Pipeline
data_type: NOAA NWS Gridded Forecasts, Climatology, Wind, Precipitation
nfl_relevance: Provides verified NOAA NWS pipeline methodology that NFLComp weather strategies reuse: NWS FORECAST vs CLIMATOLOGY badge system, hourly gridded forecasts, 50+ year climatology.
known_limitations: San Francisco specific, but pipeline reusable for NFL stadium coordinates.

name: MasterSite NFL Injury Report (buffedlizard55-lab/NFLInjuryReport)
data_type: Structured NFL Injury Reports, Alerts, Health Scores, Scorecards, Practice Participation
nfl_relevance: Primary injury source for NFLComp: 834 players tracked, DNP/LP/FP, OUT/DOUBTFUL/QUESTIONABLE, game status, alerts, health model.
historical_availability: 2026 Season Week 1-2 live; historical via weekly snapshots.
granularity: Player-level injury with practice participation and timestamps.
known_limitations: Not official NFL confirmation; cross-validated with NFL.com.

name: MasterSite NBA Injury Report (buffedlizard55-lab/NBAInjuryReport)
data_type: NBA Injury Monitoring, Rotation Impact, Lineup Impact
nfl_relevance: Methodology reuse: lineup-impact layer, rotation/starter status, alert safeguards, verification ledger. Direct NBA data not used for NFL, but methodology for severity vs rotation vs medical severity separation is reused.
known_limitations: NBA only; NFL uses separate pipeline but same verification principles.

name: MasterSite NFL Scoreboard (ESPN Hidden API)
data_type: Live NFL Scores, Play-by-Play, Box Scores, Team Stats
nfl_relevance: Live scores, in-game stats, win probability, drive info for live strategies.
known_limitations: Unofficial API may change without notice.

name: MasterSite NCAA Scoreboard (ESPN CFB)
data_type: NCAA Football Scores, Team Stats, Betting Lines
nfl_relevance: College-to-NFL translation: rookie QB usage, draft prospect performance, coaching scheme changes. Not direct NFL betting signal but useful for rookie prop strategies and coaching changes.
known_limitations: NCAA only; NFL translation is secondary signal.

name: MasterSite MLB Scoreboard
data_type: MLB Scores, Pitching, Hitting Stats
nfl_relevance: Cross-sport methodology: live win probability modeling, market making, liquidity modeling reused from MLB live models. No direct NFL signal but infrastructure reusable.

data_type: Computer Model Picks, Expert Picks, Consensus Picks
nfl_relevance: Public strategy research: model picks vs market, contrarian value, system builder.

name: MasterSite TheLeap (TradingView Breakout / Index Momentum)
data_type: Index Momentum, Breakout Rankings, Technical Indicators
nfl_relevance: Methodology reuse: breakout momentum, convex index momentum, market timing. NFL translation: team momentum (win streaks) vs market overreaction, similar to TheLeap's index momentum concept.
usage_limitations: No official data API for free tier.

name: MasterSite FDA Decisions / Drug Analysis
data_type: FDA Drug Approvals, PDUFA Dates, Clinical Trial Results
nfl_relevance: No direct NFL signal; methodology reuse for event-driven market research (FDA catalyst -> Kalshi FDA contracts KXFDA). For NFL, analogous event-driven: injury news, coaching changes, trades as catalysts.

name: MasterSite Gold / Commodities
data_type: Gold Prices, Futures, Spot, Market Data
nfl_relevance: Reviewed and flagged as NOT a direct NFL signal per KalshiPaperSim audit (Irregularity #33): Gold project is a jewelry buyer's directory, not a market signal. However, commodity trend methodology (trend following) could be applied to NFL futures.

name: MasterSite PinePilot / Pine Script Strategies
data_type: Pine Script Technical Indicators, EMA Cross, RSI, Momentum
nfl_relevance: Methodology reuse: EMA cross, momentum, mean reversion applied to NFL Elo ratings and team strength as technical indicators (e.g., Elo crossing 1500, RSI on win streaks).
known_limitations: Not NFL-specific; technical indicator methodology only.

data_type: Open Source NFL Models, EPA Models, Betting Models, Research Code
